chapter: Cincinnati, Buffalo, Russell and Fletcher Henderson
title: Paul Barbarin, songwriting and personnel on a Russell record
summary: Barbarin wrote songs too; Russell and he sometimes got paid for writing; a personnel list is read out.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: The drummer who played with you? What was his name?
Do you remember the drummer who played with you?
Oh yeah, he wrote a lot of them.
How about when Louis Russell and Paul wrote these songs, did they get paid for writing the songs?

On one of the records Louis Metcalf played trumpet, you on trombone, Albert Nicholas, Teddy Hill played tenor saxophone, Will Johnson guitar, Moore bass, Fats Picon ... /When Jay C. To EK: came to New York in 1928, did you follow his career?
